svg.title: The Golden Ratio Café — Penrose P3 rhombus tile floor
svg.desc: An overhead café interior with a genuine nonperiodic Penrose floor, made from paired golden Robinson triangles. Cream thin rhombi and russet thick rhombi fill the floor between wooden café tables, a green coffee bar and plants.
svg.text: A little order. A little wonder.
PENROSE P3 · TWO RHOMBI · NO REPEATING UNIT
